name: download remote media and save deterministically-named artifacts
definition: Obtain and run a current downloader/scraper to fetch videos and images from URLs, name files by a deterministic hash of their URL, and transcribe video content.
failure_mode: Missing or misheard frames produce commands that never reappear in the truth set.

name: emit exactly the predicted label to standard output and a result file
definition: Print only the predicted class digit to stdout when invoked and write the same single digit to a designated result file.
failure_mode: Extra output, wrong digit, or absent file fails.

name: enumerate possible neighbor pairs for a designated participant
definition: from the solution space, list each outcome where the identified guest sits directly beside the pair, accounting for rotation/symmetry.
failure_mode: missing/wrongly paired entries fail the set comparison

name: filter rows using an attribute-based domain rule
definition: Retain only rows whose domain attribute belongs to a designated set of science domains, dropping all others before counting.
failure_mode: Including the excluded domains or ignoring the filter changes the total.
